canonical_relationships: Existing model-authored service port bindings, not a reference composition.
intent_lists: Project each intent's inputs/outputs from its corresponding existing input/output bindings, keeping first-occurrence order and unique artifact ids.
missing_artifacts: Only declare already-bound, uniquely written, unused required artifact-channel status outputs on cardinality-one public ports. Never choose a new id or port binding.
metadata_note: These are declared v2 metadata choices for new diagnostic artifact declarations, not values inferred uniquely from the catalog. No report contents or business outputs are generated.
prohibited_changes: Do not change any port binding, service choice/version, parameter, fixture choice, business artifact declaration, control edge, policy, runtime setting, or existing artifact metadata. Do not invent source data or missing business artifacts.
